result.summary: Found 1 significant visual layout issue in the restaurant details section.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokomaru Ramen Bar” is visibly overlapping: the delivery time/price text collides with the “delivery • Ramen” details, making the information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Separate the delivery fee, estimated time, and cuisine into distinct flex items or rows, and ensure sufficient spacing so each text element renders without collision.
